WITH matched_data AS (
  SELECT t.*, obs.lunarstage
  FROM telescopes t
  INNER JOIN observatories obs ON t.observstation = obs.observstation
),
phase_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    lunarstage,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth,
    COUNT(DISTINCT observstation) as distinct_stations
  FROM matched_data
  GROUP BY lunarstage
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandwidth) as mean_avg FROM phase_stats
),
kept_phases AS (
  SELECT ps.lunarstage, ps.avg_bandwidth, ps.distinct_stations, om.mean_avg
  FROM phase_stats ps
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
  WHERE ps.avg_bandwidth > om.mean_avg
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_bandwidth) as avg_of_kept_averages,
  SUM(distinct_stations) as total_distinct_stations,
  AVG(avg_bandwidth - mean_avg) as avg_excess
FROM kept_phases;

assumptions.assumption: "Phases whose average is above the mean" is interpreted as strictly greater than (>), not greater than or equal to (>=).
